points.description: States that the best-case number of operations for insertion sort is N operations (i.e., linear in the number of elements), not quadratic/N^2.
points.partial_credit: Half credit for saying the best case is linear/O(N) without giving N as the operation count.

levels.says: Says the best case is linear or O(N), but does not state N operations.

points.description: Explains that N is the length, size, or number of elements of the array.
Identifies the best-case scenario as an array that is already sorted (in nondecreasing order).

rubric.notes: Full marks require both the best-case operation count N and the already-sorted input condition, with N identified as the array length. Award partial credit on P1 for saying linear/O(N) without giving the exact N operation count. No marks for giving N^2 or reverse-sorted input as the best case.
